name: Cleopatra
title: Queen of the Nile
summary: Boosts ally speed and sustains the vitality of your team
lore: Perhaps the most famous of Aaru’s queens, Cleopatra is underestimated by many who attribute her success to beauty and wiles. In fact, she is a clever politician and a brilliant tactician. Cleopatra orchestrates much of Aaru’s military defense today, though some nobles and generals still mistrust her due to her foreign heritage, a prejudice that weakens the realm’s war effort.
archetype_description: Increase outgoing healing and turn meter boosts by 1% for each piece of cloth armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Additionally, revive the ally with 40% Divinity.
Also, equalize the HP of all allies to the ally with the highest Current HP.
